label: Throws without warming up / arm soreness
description: Throws cold; stiffness or soreness from inadequate warm-up.

label: Bad base-running turns
description: Wide, slow turns; does not hit the inside of the bag.
aliases: running past bases without proper turns

label: Poor base awareness / hesitation
description: Hesitates, does not know when to advance or take a lead.

label: Slow first step / acceleration
description: Slow to accelerate out of the box or off the base.
aliases: poor body control when changing direction

label: Fear of the ball / turns away
description: Flinches, turns away, or closes eyes on an incoming ball.

label: One-handed / stabs at the ball
description: Catches one-handed or stabs instead of using two hands with soft give.

label: Backpedals / bad routes on fly balls
description: Backpedals instead of turning and running; inefficient routes.
aliases: backpedaling instead of turning and running

label: Fear of fly balls
description: Tentative or fearful tracking and catching of fly balls overhead.

label: Fields flat-footed / not in front
description: Fields standing up / flat-footed instead of low and in front.
aliases: not getting in front of the ball

label: Poor fielding footwork / approach
description: Bad approach angles, leaving holes, stabbing at the ball.

label: Slow transfer / exchange
description: Slow glove-to-hand exchange and footwork from catch to throw.
aliases: slow transitions from catch to throw

label: Barring front arm / disconnected
description: Front arm bars out and the swing disconnects from the body.

label: Casting / long swing
description: Hands drift away from the body; long, loopy bat path that is late and weak.

label: Flying open / no load
description: No load or early shoulder opening; upper and lower body fire together.
aliases: no separation between upper and lower body

label: Inconsistent / weak contact
description: Contact quality and location vary swing to swing.

label: Late / poor timing
description: Hitter is behind the pitch, especially on faster pitching.

label: Low confidence / fear at the plate
description: Hesitant or fearful in the box; reluctant to commit to a swing.

label: Lunging / poor balance
description: Weight drifts forward early; hitter lunges instead of rotating in balance.

label: Pulling head / eyes off ball
description: Head and eyes leave the ball before contact.

label: Rolling over / weak top hand
description: Wrists roll early, producing weak ground balls to the pull side.

label: Steps in the bucket
description: Front foot strides away from the plate / open instead of toward the pitcher.

label: Two-strike approach
description: Same aggressive swing in every count; no two-strike adjustment.
aliases: poor adjustment to different pitch levels

label: Uppercutting / bad swing plane
description: Swing plane does not match the pitch — big uppercut or chopping down.

label: Inconsistent release / command
description: Release point and command vary pitch to pitch.

label: Inconsistent stride / lands off-line
description: Stride length/direction varies; lands off-line to the target.

label: No hip lead / separation
description: Hips and shoulders rotate together; no separation or hip lead.
aliases: hips and shoulders rotating together (no separation)

label: Poor balance at leg lift / falls off
description: Wobbles at leg lift or falls off to the side of the mound.

label: Rushing the delivery
description: Rushes through the balance point; lower and upper half out of sync.

label: Inaccurate throws
description: Throws miss the target; no step or alignment to the target.

label: Low arm slot / sidearm
description: Elbow drops below the shoulder; ball comes out sidearm.

label: No follow-through (throwing)
description: Arm stops at release instead of finishing across the body.

label: No wrist snap
description: No wrist/finger snap at release; ball lacks backspin.

label: Poor throwing mechanics
description: General arm-path / sequencing breakdown; slinging or all-arm throws.
aliases: throwing with entire arm not forearm/wrist

label: Short-arming
description: Arm does not extend through release; throw is short and tense.

label: Weak throws / arm strength
description: Low velocity and carry; no momentum into the throw.
